scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @scratchpad/web && npm run check -w @scratchpad/docs && npm run typecheck:history
scripts.typecheck:history: npm exec -w @scratchpad/web -- tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --types node --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution Bundler --lib ES2022,DOM --strict --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck ../../scripts/validate-history.ts
scripts.test: npm run test -w @scratchpad/web && node --test scripts/verify-macos-app-release.test.mjs scripts/development-security.test.mjs scripts/backend-shard.test.mjs scripts/go-entrypoints.test.mjs
scripts.lint: biome check . && prettier --check . && markdownlint-cli2 && node scripts/check-decisions.mjs
scripts.sdk:check: node scripts/generate-clients.mjs --check && npm run typecheck -w @scratchpad/api-client && cd packages/clients/go && go test ./...
